title: Parse a Response
story: An API replied with JSON text. Turn it into Python data.
starter:
import json

raw = '{"seller": {"name": "Lakshmi", "stall": 12}}'
# parse raw, then print the seller name
hints: json.loads turns text into dicts and lists.

import json

raw = '{"seller": {"name": "Lakshmi", "stall": 12}}'
data = json.loads(raw)
print(data["seller"]["name"])
socratic: Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Parse a Response”?
solution:
import json

raw = '{"seller": {"name": "Lakshmi", "stall": 12}}'
data = json.loads(raw)
print(data["seller"]["name"])
